description: Every command is guarded by `command -v skillctl`. The plugin puts its own binary on PATH, but a platform without one, or an install that has not been reloaded yet, must degrade to a single line at session start rather than a failing hook on every skill invocation. A security check that breaks the session is a security check people remove.

hooks.command: if command -v skillctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then skillctl hook session-start; else echo 'skilltrust: no skillctl binary for this platform; see https://github.com/random1st/skilltrust'; fi
if command -v skillctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then skillctl hook pre-skill; fi
